# "The base main stat no longer additionally increases damage" companion line

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** condition, damage-pool

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game. Owner-confirmed 2026-09-02 mechanics: (1) disables ONLY the generic Main-Stat Damage Bonus (offense.py's flat 0.5%/point multiplier, main_stat_damage_bonus_disabled_flag) - an item's own explicit per-attribute lines (e.g. Ralph's Journey's "+1% Lightning Damage per 10 Dexterity") are a separate contribution and still apply normally; (2) an optional "-99% additional <A> and <B>" reduction on the item's OTHER two (non-scaling) attributes, present on both variants of Ralph's Journey and Magnus' Scar, absent on Ralph's Burial and Magnus' Jealousy - feeds the EXISTING strength_additional/dexterity_additional/intelligence_additional pools already in derive.py's attribute formula, so it cascades correctly into every other attribute-derived stat (max life, evasion, armor, etc.); (3) an optional flat bonus to the item's own scaling attribute (e.g. +75 Dexterity, midpoint of 60-90), corroded-variant-only, on all four items.
